purpose: Requirements for the forge review policy: document-based review priorities, findings as observations, option axes, backends, reviewer/evaluator verification and rule-gap handling.
summary: Background: over-proposal and double detection in AI review; shift to document-centered review with complete information at design time
Review position: findings are observations, adoption decided by the main body; quality controlled via inputs
FNC-1301/1302/1309/1311: P1-P3 priorities, criteria without judgment, fixed three-section structure, principles severity catalog
FNC-1303/1312/1310: target axis flags and preserving user-specified granularity, CLI structure
FNC-1304: interaction axis, auto-fix decided by confidence rather than severity
FNC-1313/1319/1320: focus, scope and carried-in rules and specs options
FNC-1318: backend axis, resolution order, availability check, fail-closed behavior, cleanup
FNC-1321/1322: reviewer self-verification and independent evaluator assessment with mechanical linkage
FNC-1314/1305/1306: document reference viewpoint, built-in rule fallback, issue creation for rule gaps with three conditions
Affected targets and open items TBD-1302 to TBD-1304
tasks: Adding or modifying a review backend
Deciding whether to file a rule-gap issue
title: REQ-013 レビューポリシー要件
